# workspace

Persistent workspace chat: one timeline over topic threads and episodes.

- **Runs in:** the harness process
- **Source:** [lisp/modules/harness-workspace.el](../../lisp/modules/harness-workspace.el)
- **Loaded:** when enabled (see `harness-enable-modules`)
- **Requires:** [store](store.md), [session](session.md), [agent](agent.md), [project](project.md), [workspace-knowledge](workspace-knowledge.md)
- **Brings along:** [ui-workspace](ui-workspace.md) (its UI), [small](small.md) (its file requires it)

## About

Workspace mode is one chat over many topics.  A workspace is a named,
long-lived assistant with a root directory and a list of threads.  A
thread is a topic; each live stretch of a thread is an *episode*, an
ordinary harness session of kind `workspace`.  A new episode starts
from a fresh *brief* built from the thread and from the workspace's
Logseq knowledge graph (harness-workspace-knowledge.el), not from a
compacted transcript.  The user sees the episodes and the
harness events between them as one timeline.

This module is the state layer.  It knows nothing about a buffer.  It
persists:

  workspaces/ID.json           the workspace, its threads and settings
  workspaces/ID.timeline.jsonl one line per message, divider or event

A thread's live episode is a session; its transcript is the session's,
so the old episode stays whole, searchable and openable after the
workspace has moved on.  The module subscribes to the sessions' node
and turn events to grow the timeline and the thread summary.

Routing is deliberately conservative and local.  An explicit thread,
an explicit `/new`, a thread title in the message, or the last thread
when nothing says otherwise; a topic marker makes a new thread, and a
thread is a small document the message is ranked against by the words
each holds, so a thread that holds none of a message never keeps it.
No model is asked to place a message.

## Provides

### Methods

- `workspace/brief` (id &optional opts) — Return a compact digest of workspace ID for the chat or voice.
- `workspace/cancel` (id &optional thread) — Cancel the live turn of workspace ID, or of THREAD.
- `workspace/context` (id &optional thread episode) — Return the last brief of workspace ID's THREAD.
- `workspace/create` (&rest plist) — Create a workspace.  PLIST may set :name, :root, :graph, :project,
- `workspace/delete` (id &optional delete-sessions delete-graph) — Delete workspace ID.  With DELETE-SESSIONS close its episodes too.
- `workspace/episode` (id thread &optional episode) — Return the session and state of THREAD's episode in workspace ID.
- `workspace/get` (id) — Return workspace ID with its threads.
- `workspace/list` (&optional filter) — List workspaces, newest last.  FILTER may name a root.
- `workspace/open` (id) — Return workspace ID and its last thread, creating no episode.
- `workspace/prompt` (id text &optional opts) — Send TEXT to workspace ID and return the turn's promise.
- `workspace/resources/status` (id) — Return workspace ID's browser, wallet, access and credential resources.
- `workspace/status` (id) — Return what the workspace ID knows about its state.
- `workspace/thread` (id thread) — Return THREAD of workspace ID with its episodes.
- `workspace/thread/create` (id title &optional plist) — Create a thread TITLE in workspace ID and return it.
- `workspace/thread/delete` (id thread &optional delete-sessions) — Remove THREAD from workspace ID; its page and episodes stay by default.
- `workspace/thread/merge` (id from into) — Merge thread FROM of workspace ID into thread INTO.
- `workspace/thread/park` (id thread) — Park THREAD of workspace ID at the next turn boundary.
- `workspace/thread/revive` (id thread &optional opts) — Start a new episode of THREAD in workspace ID.
- `workspace/thread/update` (id thread &rest plist) — Change THREAD of workspace ID.
- `workspace/threads` (id &optional filter) — Return the threads of workspace ID, newest first.
- `workspace/timeline` (id &optional opts) — Return timeline entries of workspace ID, oldest first.
- `workspace/update` (id &rest plist) — Change workspace ID.  PLIST may set its name, root, project, defaults
- `workspace/wallet/authorization/create` (id &rest plist) — Ask for a bounded purchase authorization for workspace ID.
- `workspace/wallet/authorization/revoke` (id authorization) — Revoke purchase AUTHORIZATION in workspace ID and return the resources.
- `workspace/wallet/purchase/decide` (id purchase decision) — Decide a proposed PURCHASE in workspace ID: allow or deny it.

### Events

- `workspace/changed` — (ID WORKSPACE) when a workspace record changed.
- `workspace/context-built` — (ID THREAD BRIEF) when a brief was built.
- `workspace/deleted` — (ID) when a workspace was deleted.
- `workspace/episode-changed` — (ID THREAD SESSION DIVIDER) when an episode started or ended.
- `workspace/knowledge-changed` — (WORKSPACE OP) when a block was written to the workspace's Logseq graph.
- `workspace/thread-changed` — (ID THREAD) when a thread changed.
- `workspace/timeline-appended` — (ID ENTRY) when a timeline entry was appended.

### Options

- `harness-workspace-brief-chars` — Most characters a workspace brief may hold.
- `harness-workspace-brief-recent` — Messages of the thread a brief quotes.
- `harness-workspace-directory` — Default root directory of a new workspace.
- `harness-workspace-episode-context` — Share of an episode's context window at which a new episode starts.
- `harness-workspace-episode-turns` — Turns after which a workspace episode is continued in a new one.
- `harness-workspace-max-message-chars` — Most characters of one message the timeline keeps.
- `harness-workspace-model` — Model a workspace episode runs on, or nil for the configured model.
- `harness-workspace-non-interactive` — Whether a workspace episode starts non-interactive.
- `harness-workspace-notify` — Whether the workspace sends a notification when a reply is ready.
- `harness-workspace-permission-mode` — Permission mode of a workspace episode.
- `harness-workspace-recall` — Knowledge blocks a brief recalls from the Logseq graph.
- `harness-workspace-router-recent` — Messages of a thread the router reads for its words.
- `harness-workspace-router-semantic` — Whether an embedding model re-ranks a close routing call.
- `harness-workspace-router-threshold` — How much of a message a thread must hold to be its topic.
- `harness-workspace-router-timeout` — Seconds the semantic re-rank may take before the words decide.
- `harness-workspace-thinking` — Thinking level a workspace episode runs at, or nil for the session default.
- `harness-workspace-thread-idle-hours` — Hours after which a message starts a new episode in the same thread.
